title: Inspissate
summary: INSPIS'SATE, verb transitive [Latin in and spissus, thick.] To thicken, as fluids; to bring to greater consistence by evaporating the thinner parts, etc.

inlines.v: INSPIS'SATE, verb transitive [Latin in and spissus, thick.] To thicken, as fluids; to bring to greater consistence by evaporating the thinner parts, etc.
